newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS DAY SOFTER ON MAJOR UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS DAY SOFTER ON MAJOR UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Tuesday's session weaker against major currencies, but foreign exchange dealers said the local central bank had eased importer pressure on the market by chipping in millions of dollars.
"The market turned out to be more active than we initially indicated, with lots of payments and fewer receipts," one dealer said.
"The (central) Reserve Bank had to come in, chipping in to ease the shortage and smooth the market, but we still continued to see pressure on the Zimbabwe dollar," he added.
At Monday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 10.3700/3941 on the U.S. dollar from 10.3700/3900 late on Monday and was also easier on the South African rand at 2.2900/2950 from 2.2860/2930.
It fell to 16.2360/2760 on sterling from 16.2100/2490 and firmed to 6.7610/7825 on the mark compared to 6.7770/7930.
